signal: Vision Group Retail unified its acquisitions of Maxerience, SMSB, and Hivery under one brand and platform in early 2026

email.subject1: a signal play for Vision Group
email.body1:
Caysie, saw Vision Group Retail unified Maxerience, SMSB, and Hivery into one brand and platform this year.

Bringing acquisitions under one motion usually means more in-market accounts than the team can cover before signals go stale, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for Vision Group off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Caysie, quick follow-up for Vision Group.

With a newly unified platform, pipeline expectations tend to outpace what headcount can cover, and most teams don't actually know how many meetings they need to hit the number. The gap shows up late, then it's a scramble to recover the quarter.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Vision Group needs this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Caysie, last bit of proof for Vision Group.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Vision Group's reply rate likely compares to other retail-tech teams. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through it?
email.body4:
Caysie, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Unifying three acquisitions is its own kind of busy, and timing matters.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your motion? I'll tailor it to Vision Group either way.
